method: WP-7.1 fleet reproducibility sweep — rebuild at candidate commit, normalise, keccak-compare
caveat: A commit here reproduces the deployed bytecode; it is not proof it is the commit that was deployed, since commits frequently share a source closure. Treat as an attestation about the code, not as recovered deployment provenance.
scope: EVM only. zkEVM slots are excluded because the sweep does not record which zksolc version produced the match, and zksolc pins zk codegen.
